about: Battle intro index for PUWBattleIntro. fronts: PUW trainer class -> held front sprite (build 6 copies source_file to file). strips: player back throw strips with real frame data. protagonist_backs: null = NO strip held for that protagonist (gap G-VS2) -- the sequencer runs ball-only release instead of showing a wrong character's back.
